translation.name: Waom Yesu Wane Sigi Maep Don

content: Mali Malip Korop Ŋo Kepe Wane Tanik Manik Borikine Maket Birakayake
Ŋei maneŋo Yesu wane Kristo raki paki malip kayake, eŋe Anutu wane medep, ŋo mane eŋe magaine wet maep okankayake, eŋe medep yalewaka wet maep okankayake.
Ŋene Anutu wet maep okankaŋem paki, pi donine tewekkeneo, yemo Anutu wane ŋei ŋerewekoune wet maep okanonmaine, yewa wane kine qe wakoniake.
Ŋene Anutu yaup mi wet maep okankaikene, so eŋane pidonŋo ŋenano umatne mi okanmaike, midakaka,

onoka wane, Anutuŋo eŋane ŋerep medep gege togon ebonge, eŋe kepeo umat me wikile kine kine ŋine korop kito peseki ket okanmaike, yemo ŋenze mali malipŋo, yalewa oken okane more kepe wane tanik manik yuanka ma pesekakene.
Maŋo kawali qe yuangi paki kepe wane tanik manik ma pese okanmaike? Ŋei mane eŋe Yesu, Anutu wane Gipole, yale raki paki malipkayakeŋo weku yale okaniake.
Anutuŋo Yesu Kristo Wane Don Didiwo Ra Wakonge

Yesu Kristo eŋe wekuŋo lotkeke, eŋe dokuŋo tauon tauon ea wane tanik manik so kibego weŋemine ket ket, ea wane tanik manik yewarop sari lotkeke, eŋe dokuropka mi sari lotkeke, eŋe dokurop so weŋem gorop weneŋ sari lotkeke. Asuŋo oŋom kine ra wakone ramaike, iwa welekatne, onoka wane, Asu eŋe don wele ea wane welaine so kine.
Anutu wane don ŋei karewe edo ra wakon okanmami.
Asu, doku so weŋem, eŋe karewe, ŋo kineene yemo weku.
Ŋeiŋo don qesi qesiŋ okane rau detŋem, welekatne okan okanmaike. Ŋo Anutuŋo donine qesiŋkake, yemo wele zok manerop okan okanmaike, eŋe Gipolane don qesiŋka more ra wakonge.

Ea wane ŋei mane eŋe Anutu wane Gipole detlukkayake, eŋe Anutu wane don wele eaŋo kotino pamaniake. Ŋo mane eŋe Anutu wane don detki don yauwine okangi mi detlukkayake, paki Anutu eŋe isi ŋei yale okaniake, ŋei yaline eŋe Anutuŋo Gipolane kine ra wakonge, ea mi dere malipkayake.
Ŋene tanik manik yaline eaŋo sikan ŋonmaike, yemo Anutu wane don eamo welekatne, Anutu wisika gege, so gege togon ŋebonge, ea wane kine so welaine yemo Gipolano pamaike.
Ŋei mane eŋe Anutu wane Gipolerop gemaike, eŋe wisika gegeine pamaike, ŋo mane eŋe Anutu Gipolerop mi gemaike, eŋano wisika gege ea mo mane mi pamaike.
Wisika Gege So Gege Togon Mat
Na don iwa qemaile, yemo ŋine ŋei ŋerep korop Anutu Gipolane eŋetine dere malipka gemami, ŋine maine desikei, ŋene Gege Togon mo makone, yale desikei.
Ŋene Anutu wane kaitko togole gekene, onoka wane ŋene yale detmaine, ŋene kine kine mane wane Anutu wane simile pamaike, yewao mogare meŋenkaŋem eŋe meŋe meŋenze detki paki ŋeboniake.
Ŋene meŋenkaikene rokop, eŋe detŋoniake, iwa welekatne, ŋene yalewaka detŋem paki kine kine oŋo ŋeboniakane meŋenkaŋem eŋe ŋeboniake.

Ŋei mane eŋe kimaine kaki borikine mayake, borikine yalineŋo tebakaki seu seu wane rokop mi okaniake, eŋe yaline kaki paki, Anutu meŋenkaki oŋo gege togon maniake, iwa yemo ŋei borikine ewekine ma okanmami, eŋane ramaile. Ŋo borikine umatneŋo tebaongi seu seu wane biŋek oka okan eŋe pamaike, ŋo na yaline eŋane Anutu meŋen kaikenane mi ramaile.
Masi tanik qotkoine korop yewa eŋe sot turuŋ weneŋ okanmaike, ŋo borikine natne yemo tebaongi seu seuo mi arikei.

Ŋene iwa yale detmaine, ŋei ŋerep Anutu wane dokoine okane gege togon gemami, eŋe borikine takotki takot mi ma okanmami, onoka wane eŋe Anutu wane Gipoleŋo warekaki tikŋaneŋ gemaike, wane Satanŋo maine mi matalikayake.
Ŋene detmaine, ŋene Anutu wane ŋerep medewekoune, ŋo kepe baŋem korop Anutu wane don ŋadekka okanmami, eŋe Satan ŋo ŋei waom okan ongi eŋane bango gemami.

Ŋene iwa yale detmaine, Anutu wane Gipole eŋe ketki paki, wet dereretze ma wakone ŋebongane, ŋene Anutu welekatne eŋe detka okanmaine, ŋenane gegezeŋo yemo Anutu welekatne eŋano pamaike, so Gipole Yesu Kristo wano weneŋ pamaike, eŋe Anutu welekatne so iwa eŋe gege togon.
Gipon borasokopne, ŋine Anutu isisine yewa korop ŋadekon warekei!
